races.display_title: Betway British EBF Rosemary Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict: A final chance is given to ARISAIG , who hasn't won since summer 2024 but Charlie Johnston's mare is clearly capable of winning races at this level provided things drop right. Alobayyah was progressive prior to her Haydock blip last month, so she's put forward as the main danger, while Estissa and Gilding The Lily are a couple of progressive 3-y-os who may also be involved at the business end, too. ARISAIG ALOBAYYAH ESTISSA

races.verdict: It's hard to put much faith in a 15-race maiden, but CONDOTTI has gone close a few times this season and this could be the day Hugo Palmer's 4-y-o finally puts it all together. Falcon Nine has been threatening to come good of late, so he could be the one to provide most resistance, with Sweet Kiss and Ablon a couple of 4-y-o fillies not out of things, either CONDOTTI (IRE) FALCON NINE SWEET KISS

races.verdict: DAVY CROCKETT didn't go on as expected over hurdles (also fell sole chase start) but got his career back on track with the help of the stewards when making a successful debut in this sphere at Tramore 6 weeks ago. Promising to be suited by this longer trip and open to improvement, he edges preference over Joseph O'Brien's Delta , who is more than capable but has become frustrating.
